forms:
<$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,7)>Ha-HA! You scared?!
<$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,666)><$facial(3,9)>Huh. <$voicel(3,5)>I, uh...I guess not. Darn.
<$voicel(3,3)><$comeff(3,17)><$motion(3,663)>Maybe I’ve gotten rusty... It’s been a hot minute since
I tried to scare a human.

<$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)>Oh, yeah! I was bumpin’ some <$cdef(27)>tunes!
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,666)>And, uh... Who are you?
Wait, you’re...not a human?
You’re...a <$cdef(27)>Ditto?!
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,27)>Yoooooo! That transformation is WILD! I thought you were
actually a human!

<$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,665)>Whaaat?! Yooo! You’re...a <$cdef(27)>Ditto?! Whoa! <$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,38)>That transformation
is WILD!
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,666)>So, uh... Anyway... I guess you came to check stuff out
’cause you heard some noise?
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,661)>My bad, yo! I was just bumpin’ some <$cdef(27)>tunes!

<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)>I can go into all sorts of machines ’n’ electronics, y’know?
<$voicel(3,8)><$comeff(3,5)><$motion(3,659)>This one is SUPER cool! It plays music!!!
<$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,806)>I was waitin’ here alone hopin’ someone would come
along, but no one ever did... So I’ve been playin’ music
to keep the mood high and the vibes right!

<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,14)>But, hey! Now that YOU’RE here, <$cdef(27)>Ditto, how ’bout listenin’
to some hot tracks with me before you run off?!

<$voicel(3,3)><$comeff(3,6)><$facial(3,9)>Huh? You don’t have time for that?
<$motion(0,824)><$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,14)><$motion(3,827)>Because all the humans and Pokémon disappeared?! Yooo!
Seriously?!
<$voicel(3,7)><$facial(3,1)><$comeff(3,6)>But the Pokémon are slowly comin’ back, you say? Hm...
<$voicel(3,6)><$comeff(3,3)>And you’re tryin’ to make a new town with great vibes?<$motion(3,654)><$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,39)>That is SO cool! Yo, I wanna help out too!
<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,49)>Guess I won’t waste any more time just sittin’ around here!
<$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,14)>I’ll see ya again in a bit!

<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,49)>I wanna help you make the town a vibe, yo! But lemme go
meet everybody else first!
